headline: 92% of students now use AI in their studies, up from 66% one year earlier

figures.page_quote: According to the latest available data, 92% of students use AI in their studies.
figures.primary_source: Higher Education Policy Institute, Student Generative AI Survey 2025 (1,041 full-time UK undergraduates, polled by Savanta, published 26 Feb 2025): https://www.hepi.ac.uk/2025/02/26/student-generative-ai-survey-2025/ — confirmed: "The proportion of students reporting using any AI tool has jumped from 66% last year to 92% this year."

figures.page_quote: The study also showed a sharp increase from 66% to 92% in the space of a year, underscoring how quickly generative technologies have been integrated into academic life.
figures.primary_source: Higher Education Policy Institute, Student Generative AI Survey 2025 (1,041 full-time UK undergraduates, polled by Savanta, published 26 Feb 2025): https://www.hepi.ac.uk/2025/02/26/student-generative-ai-survey-2025/ — confirmed, same sentence as above.

figures.page_quote: The same survey revealed that nearly 9 in 10 students (88%) acknowledged using generative AI tools like ChatGPT for tests in 2025, compared to just over half (53%) in 2024.
figures.primary_source: Higher Education Policy Institute, Student Generative AI Survey 2025 (1,041 full-time UK undergraduates, polled by Savanta, published 26 Feb 2025): https://www.hepi.ac.uk/2025/02/26/student-generative-ai-survey-2025/ — confirmed: "The proportion of students using generative AI tools such as ChatGPT for assessments has jumped from 53% last year to 88% this year."

figures.page_quote: Conversely, being accused of cheating (53%) is the main reason students are reluctant to use AI.
figures.primary_source: Higher Education Policy Institute, Student Generative AI Survey 2025 (1,041 full-time UK undergraduates, polled by Savanta, published 26 Feb 2025): https://www.hepi.ac.uk/2025/02/26/student-generative-ai-survey-2025/ — confirmed: "The main factors putting students off using AI are being accused of cheating (said by 53% of respondents) and getting false results or 'hallucinations' (51%)."

figures.page_quote: Getting false results/hallucinations | 51% (row 2 of the table "most common reasons students avoid using AI tools")
figures.primary_source: Higher Education Policy Institute, Student Generative AI Survey 2025 (1,041 full-time UK undergraduates, polled by Savanta, published 26 Feb 2025): https://www.hepi.ac.uk/2025/02/26/student-generative-ai-survey-2025/ — confirmed, same sentence as the 53% figure.

alt_text: 92% of students now use AI in their studies, up from 66% one year earlier. Source: HEPI survey of UK undergraduates, 2025.
